summary: 68-year-old female from Longmont fell and injured her ankle on the Fourmile Canyon Link Trail at Betasso Preserve; Fourmile Fire, Sunshine Fire, Boulder County Open Space Rangers and Rocky Mountain Rescue Group stabilized her and carried her by litter to a waiting ambulance; AMR took her to a local hospital with ankle injuries (~1-hr rescue; BCSO case 22-2832)
location: Fourmile Canyon Link Trail, Betasso Preserve
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain Rescue Group, Boulder County Sheriff's Office, Fourmile Fire, Sunshine Fire, Boulder County Open Space, American Medical Response
